fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-06-18 states that a red-coloured mobile phone of the complainant went missing after a brief push in a crowded stretch at Mullai Park Shopping Complex, on 2025-06-16 at roughly 15:05. Rajeshwari Ammal submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000242. The complainant could not identify the person involved. The incident reportedly occurred on or near a bus bearing registration TN-45-ZZ-1062. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage, photographs and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Phone allegedly lifted during a brief distraction in a crowded area.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, bus, afternoon, shopping complex, CCTV, photograph
